title: Count the 1 bits of a word, fast
task: Put in a0 the number of 1 bits of the word at value, then stop with ebreak, within 40 clock cycles from the start. A loop over 32 bits takes longer: Hazard3 has the bit-manipulation extensions. Keep the label value: the tests write it.
starter:
# count-ones -- practice exercise (MAVILERA, Pico 2)
# Put in a0 the number of 1 bits of the word at value, then ebreak, within 40 clock cycles.
# Hint: look for an instruction of the Zbb extension that counts bits (the Instructions view's
# tour template shows the extensions).
        .text
_start: li      a0, 0                   # replace with your code
        ebreak

        .data
value:  .word   0                       # the tests write the word here
